draft.title: perf(solo): keep prepared artwork in owned binary images
draft.body:
Solo candidate artwork currently becomes a base64 data URL before decoding. Keep the verified image bytes binary through the existing picture owner, with the URL retained until decode and display ownership finish. Studio serialization remains compatible, and cancellation/release still dispose owned resources.

Adds eleven top-level controls plus one nested cleanup control for integrity, decoding, cancellation, Main readiness and URL ownership. The held source is unchanged by this main integration. Source review is complete; hosted source and build checks are pending. Keep draft for qualification; no device or measured performance pass is claimed.

draft.title: perf(core): avoid temporary trail copies during movement
draft.body:
Trail contact checks currently copy every prior segment and allocate temporary cell-index arrays, including callbacks with no movement. Reuse read-only segment references and construct cell sets directly only when needed, preserving contact order, clipping and collision calculations.

Adds five controls for empty movement, immutable long trails, contact horizons, repeated cells and append ownership. The reviewed implementation is unchanged; this merge only brings in current main. Hosted source checks are pending. Keep draft for qualification; no measured speed or replay-compatibility pass is claimed.
